decisions.reason: Passenger data transmission has quantified results that meet aspirations (UK Home Office use, over 30 government API schemes), and the expanding firm has the slack to keep it as a core aviation offering.

The travel health requirements API reports no results and its post-pandemic relevance is fading, but it is cheap to maintain, fits the aviation data portfolio, and the growing firm's slack lets it carry the product rather than start problemistic search.

The travel and document verification platform sits close to the established offer and complements the passenger data products, and the firm's growth and slack support keeping it despite no reported results.
